originalTitle: Jackie, a beloved bald eagle and livestream star, dies of mysterious illness
summary: Thousands mourn the death of the eagle at California’s Big Bear Lake, whose life was closely followed via livestream
content: Jackie – the beloved bald eagle at California’s Big Bear Lake whose livestream was followed by millions of viewers as she birthed and raised chicks – died on Monday due to a mysterious illness. She was 14. Jackie had been receiving treatment at the Ojai Raptor Center since mid-July when she was found weak and unable to fly after a scuffle with two younger eagles. Experts at the center had discovered that she was suffering from severe anemia, and suspected she had been sick for weeks before the fight grounded her. “We know this news will be deeply felt by the many thousands of people around the world who have followed her journey, hoped alongside us, prayed for her, and supported the people caring for her,” the raptor center staff wrote in an Instagram post announcing Jackie’s death. “Our team is heartbroken. It has been an extraordinary privilege to care for her. “ Despite administering a number of tests including a CT scan and bone marrow biopsy, experts at the center said they could not determine what had sickened Jackie. The center is in consultation with the US and California fish and wildlife services about Jackie’s condition, and “will provide a more comprehensive statement including additional information on her treatments and test results” at a later date, it said. The public had been watching Jackie’s nest since a livestream was first set up in October 2015 – it was then inhabited by her parents Ricky and Lucy. In 2018, the public watched as Jackie defended her nest against an intruder, dubbed Mr B. Then, Shadow – the male eagle who became her mate – moved in. Greater and greater numbers of viewers tuned in during the pandemic to watch the couple build their lives together and welcome several clutches of fluffy hatchlings. In January, the couple’s clutch of two eggs was eaten by ravens. Jackie laid two more eggs in February, and thousands watched as the couple hatched their two youngest – Luna and Sandy. The latter was named after Sandy Steers, the executive director of Friends of Big Bear Valley, who had recently died from cancer. The couple inspired the public to fight for the environment they inhabited. The Friends of Big Bear Lake launched a $10m effort to buy land near the eagles’ nest which had been slated for development – drawing support from the local elementary school, as well as from OpenAI co-founder Greg Brockman and his wife, Anna. The non-profit will now steward 63 acres of the land. Fans of Jackie shared messages of grief following the news of her death – and celebrated her legacy of inspiring a massive public campaign for preserving natural habitat.
chineseTitle: 深受喜爱的秃鹰和直播明星杰基因神秘疾病去世
chineseSummary: 数千人哀悼加州大熊湖老鹰的死亡，人们通过直播密切关注它的生活
chineseContent: 杰基是加州大熊湖备受喜爱的秃鹰，她的直播吸引了数百万观众观看她生下和养育小鸡的过程。杰基于周一因一种神秘疾病去世。她当时 14 岁。自 7 月中旬以来，杰基一直在奥海猛禽中心接受治疗，当时她在与两只年轻的老鹰扭打后被发现虚弱且无法飞行。该中心的专家发现她患有严重贫血，并怀疑她在比赛停飞之前已经病了数周。猛禽中心工作人员在 Instagram 上宣布杰基去世的消息中写道：“我们知道，全世界成千上万的人都会深深地感受到这个消息，他们关注着她的旅程，与我们一起希望，为她祈祷，并支持照顾她的人们。” “我们的团队心碎了。能够照顾她真是一种荣幸。”尽管进行了包括 CT 扫描和骨髓活检在内的多项检查，该中心的专家表示，他们无法确定杰姬的病因。该中心正在与美国和加利福尼亚州的鱼类和野生动物服务机构就杰姬的病情进行磋商，并称稍后“将提供更全面的声明，包括有关她的治疗和测试结果的更多信息”。自 2015 年 10 月首次直播以来，公众一直在关注杰姬的巢穴——当时她的父母瑞奇和露西居住在其中。 2018 年，公众观看了杰基保卫自己的巢穴，抵御被称为 B 先生的入侵者。然后，成为她伴侣的雄鹰影子搬了进来。在疫情期间，越来越多的观众收看这对夫妇共同建设生活，并迎来几窝毛茸茸的幼鸟。一月份，这对夫妇生了两个孩子
